tool_schemas.name: ref_search_documentation
tool_schemas.description: Searches indexed documentation within the given workspace for the provided free‑text query and returns a paged list of matching documents/snippets, optionally filtered by source_id, language, and document status and ordered by the requested sort; pagination is controlled by limit and an opaque cursor returned with each page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/source_id formats are invalid, query is empty, limit/cursor/sort/status are invalid, or other parameters violate the schema. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace (or specified source_id within it) does not exist.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (ref_wsp_...) to scope the documentation search.

query.description: Free-text query to search across indexed documentation content.

source_id.description: Optional documentation source ULID (ref_src_...) to restrict results to a single source.

language.description: Optional language code to filter documents (e.g., en, en-US).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: ref_read_url
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the given URL, converts the response content to markdown, and returns the markdown along with read metadata; when use_cache is true it may return a previously cached conversion for the same workspace+URL, and when force_refresh is true it will re-fetch/re-convert even if a cached entry exists. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid workspace_id, non-URI/empty url, invalid timeout_ms, or conflicting cache options (e.g., force_refresh=true while use_cache=false if not supported). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace, NOT_FOUND when the URL cannot be fetched (e.g., DNS/connection/HTTP 404) or the workspace does not exist, REQUEST_TIMEOUT when timeout_ms is exceeded, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when rate limits are hit.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (ref_wsp_...) to scope caching and auditing of reads.

url.description: The URL to fetch and convert to markdown.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow serving a cached conversion when available.

force_refresh.description: Whether to bypass cache and fetch/convert again even if a cached entry exists.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to allow for fetch+conversion.

tool_schemas.name: ref_get_current_actor
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity for this request, including actor/workspace context, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the credential is missing/invalid.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace ULID (ref_wsp_...) to return workspace-scoped quota and effective permissions; when omitted, returns the actor's default workspace if any.

tool_schemas.name: ref_list_documentation_sources
tool_schemas.description: Lists documentation sources for the given workspace with optional filtering by status and source_type and returns a paged result set; refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids/filters or UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (ref_wsp_...) to list sources for.

limit.description: Maximum number of sources to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: ref_create_documentation_source
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new documentation source in the given workspace for indexing; returns the created source record and refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields, CONFLICT if a source with the same name/base_url already exists in the workspace, or FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot write to the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (ref_wsp_...) that will own the source.

base_url.description: Base URL for website/sitemap/openapi sources; required for source_type=website|sitemap|openapi.

repo_url.description: Repository URL for git_repo sources; required for source_type=git_repo.

default_locale.description: Optional locale/language hint for this source (e.g., en, en-US).

status.description: Initial status for the source; defaults to active when omitted.

tool_schemas.name: ref_update_documentation_source
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields of an existing documentation source (including lifecycle transitions active/paused/deleted) and returns the updated record; refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid updates, NOT_FOUND if the source does not exist in the workspace, or CONFLICT if attempting an illegal status transition.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (ref_wsp_...) that owns the source.

status.description: New lifecycle status; allowed transitions: active→paused|deleted, paused→active|deleted.

tool_schemas.name: ref_list_read_url_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists URL read/audit requests for the given workspace ordered by most recent first, with optional filtering by status and normalized_url/url; returns a paged result set and refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters or FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (ref_wsp_...) to list requests for.

url.description: Optional filter to requests whose original url matches exactly.

normalized_url.description: Optional filter to requests whose normalized_url matches exactly (canonicalized URL used for caching).

since.description: Only return requests created at or after this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of requests to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: ref_get_url_content_cache_entry
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single URL content cache entry by id for the given workspace and returns its stored markdown/text and fetch metadata; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the entry does not exist in the workspace or FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (ref_wsp_...) that owns the cache entry.

cache_entry_id.description: URL content cache ULID (ref_cache_...) to fetch.
